title: wawesome template manifest
description: A requirements declaration: what a template is, what it needs before it can run, and what the user should do once it is deployed. It declares; the CLI satisfies each requirement through an endpoint the platform already ships.

name.description: The template's identity: what a user types after `--template`, and the directory it lives in inside the repository archive. One name, so there is nothing to disagree with itself.

title.description: Human-readable name for the gallery and the CLI list.

description.description: One sentence a visitor can decide on within a few seconds.

ref.description: The stable git ref the CLI fetches. A flat tag, never a slashed name: git cannot hold both a ref named for a template and refs nested beneath it, and a slash is rewritten as a hyphen inside the fetched archive's root directory. CI advances this tag only after the template smoke-deploys against the published CLI.

env.description: The environment variables to prompt for, each with a pointer to where its value is found.

required.description: Whether the Function is non-functional without it.

secret.description: Stored write-only, never readable back. Anything credential-shaped is secret.

where_to_find.description: Where in the third-party's own dashboard the value is, so the user does not have to search their documentation.

providers.description: Outbound providers from the platform's egress catalogue that the template calls. Empty for an inbound-only template.

post_deploy.description: Printed after a successful deploy. `{{url}}` is interpolated with the Function's public URL — the only placeholder anywhere in the template system, and it never touches a source file.
